---
title: "ARIMA"
output: html_document
---

Set up:

```{r}
#install.packages("forecast")
library(forecast)
library(tidyverse)
orpi_biomass <- read_csv("../data_clean/orpi_total_biomass.csv")
saguaro_biomass <- read_csv("../data_clean/saguaro_total_biomass.csv")
```

Convert into time series format:

```{r}
orpi_ts <- ts(data = orpi_biomass$biomass_g, start = 1991, end = 2023, frequency = 1)
```

Run auto-arima function/messing around:

```{r}
auto_fit <- auto.arima(orpi_ts)
summary(auto_fit)
plot(auto_fit)

autoplot(auto_fit)
autoplot(orpi_ts)
```

```{r}
combo_biomass <- orpi_biomass %>% 
  inner_join(saguaro_biomass, join_by(year)) %>% 
  rename(orpi_biomass = biomass_g.x,
         saguaro_biomass = biomass_g.y)

ggplot(combo_biomass, aes(x = orpi_biomass, y = saguaro_biomass)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw()
```
